d:
The Indian Youth Congress has launched protests against Meta, accusing the company of restricting accounts and posts critical of the government.
The protests took place outside Meta offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram, with allegations of political censorship.
Youth Congress has issued a seven-day ultimatum, demanding answers over restrictions on opposition leaders, journalists and content creators.
The Hyderabad protest also witnessed vandalism, including flower pots being broken, while police detained several protesters.
